Contributing to ggsaveR

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for considering a contribution. Bug reports, feature requests and pull requests are all welcome.

Reporting a bug

Open an issue with a minimal reproducible example, ideally made with the reprex package. Include the output of sessionInfo() and the ggsaveR options you had set (ggsaveR::ggsaveR_options() lists them).

Proposing a change

For anything beyond a small fix, please open an issue first to discuss the change.

  1. Fork the repository and create a branch.
  2. Make your change, and add tests in tests/testthat/ for new behaviour or bug fixes.
  3. Update the roxygen comments and run devtools::document().
  4. Add a bullet to the top of NEWS.md describing the change.
  5. Check that devtools::check() passes without errors, warnings or notes.
  6. Open a pull request.

Design principles

  • With no options set, ggsave() must behave exactly like ggplot2::ggsave().
  • New behaviour is switched on with an option, so that existing scripts need no changes.
  • Options are validated, and invalid values give a clear error.
  • Keep hard dependencies to a minimum; optional features go in Suggests.

Code of conduct

Please be respectful and constructive. This project follows the Contributor Covenant.
